description: Tactile experience and texture
evolution_note: Central theme of the collection, emphasizing the importance of touch and texture.
evidence: Tactile. Texture. Textile. The collection is an exploration of color and texture: glistening, fragmented jacquard; sumptuous, layered knits; and supple yet lightweight leather shaped by light and craft. A reminder that tactile experience is elemental — stimulating the senses, triggering memory, affirming presence — just as clothes do against the skin.
